title: Dubai Gets Its First Niche Perfumery Fair With Notes Dubai
summary: Messe Frankfurt Middle East's new show, a sister event to Notes Shanghai, opens at the Dubai Mall Exhibition Centre in January. Its debut theme was unveiled in Cannes.

extraction.key_fact: 두바이에 최초의 니치 향수 박람회인 노츠 두바이가 개최된다.
